baselines.description: Declared before any candidate is evaluated. At minimum a trivial predictor (e.g. empirical marginal distribution of the held-out symbols).
baselines.rule: Baselines are frozen in the profile before candidate submission; adding or changing baselines after seeing results invalidates the run.

blinding: Evaluator seals the held-out traces (hash published) before any candidate is submitted. Candidates are evaluated blind; the seal is opened only after all candidate description lengths and predictions are committed.

candidate_encodings.description: Each candidate explanation must be submitted as a fixed, deterministic program whose description length is computable and charged in full against its gain.
candidate_encodings.rule: No candidate may be modified after the held-out data are unsealed.

energy: Where applicable, record energy consumed (joules) alongside gain so Turing yield (T/J) can be computed; energy instrumentation method must be declared in the profile.
freeze_procedure: To be defined before freezing: profile hash published, sealed data hash published, candidate submission window closed, then evaluation.
name: Omega-trace instrument validation
objective: Determine whether the Turing measurement reproduces on real Omega execution traces: does the instrument work reproducibly before any scientific claim is made with it?
quantity_measured: Turing gain (T) of candidate explanatory programs over declared baselines on sealed held-out Omega traces

quantizer.description: Continuous observations are encoded as declared quantized symbols per Assumption A3 of the formal paper. The quantizer is a required profile field.
quantizer.spec: PLACEHOLDER - to be fixed at freeze time: uniform bin width, number of bins, and bin edge convention must be declared here before freezing.

seeds: All random seeds fixed and recorded in the profile before freezing; any stochastic component of the evaluator must be reproducible from the recorded seeds.
uncertainty: Report Turing gain with confidence intervals from the declared resampling procedure; recomputation by an independent party from the frozen profile must fall inside the reported envelope.
verdict_rules: Positive Turing gain on sealed held-out data is required for a candidate to count as an explanation.
Noise controls (randomized candidate encodings) must NOT show positive gain; a positive control gain invalidates the instrument, not the candidate.
Recomputation from the frozen profile and sealed data must reproduce the reported gain within the declared uncertainty envelope.
